View and edit this document in Word on your computer, tablet, or phone. You can edit
text; easily insert content such as pictures, shapes, or tables; and seamlessly save the
document to the cloud from Word on your Windows, Mac, Android, or iOS device.
Want to insert a picture from your files or add a shape, text box, or table? You got it! On
the Insert tab of the ribbon, just tap the option you need.
Find even more easy-to-use tools on the Insert tab, such as to add a hyperlink or insert a
comment.
To update the contact information at the bottom of the document, double click in the
footer, select the item you wish to update, and begin typing!
